messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we've published a small but important update to the handbook on caregiver/parental leave coordination with short-term disability and intermittent leave. Please review the changes and acknowledge if you sign off on manager approvals. Link: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Maya (People Ops): We're also launching a ~10min microlearning for managers + manager-facing folks. Completion required by Apr 12. Recruiting/onboarding: include this in the 30-day checklist for new hires who will be managers. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xxx-TrackerLink

Eli (Recruiting): Quick Q—should new manager hires complete within first 14 days? We can patch into the offer/onboarding flow.

Jules (HR Support): Yes—managers must complete within 14 days. General ICs/managers-facing ICs should complete by Apr 12. We'll add a column for "onboarding due date" on the tracker.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Contractors—do long-term contractors need this? Some are vendor staff.

Jules (HR Support): Mandatory for W2 employees and contractors who make people decisions. Add contractor flag in tracker; escalate vendor exceptions to people-ops@redwood.

Lina (Legal): Reviewed the wording: two tiny edits suggested (examples for "eligible caregiver" and clarify the retro window). Also reminder: EU acknowledgements must be retained for 3 years.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Lina—added an "EU" flag to the tracker and accepted edits. We'll snapshot the handbook after legal sign-off and send a policy announcement.

Maya (People Ops): Optional Q&A drop-ins next week: Tue 11am PT, Thu 4pm PT. RSVP in Col G on tracker.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled—automated manager reminders will run Apr 5 for unconfirmed teams.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Can initial manager ack be an emoji in the sheet? I can spare a quick click per team. :sweat_smile:

Maya (People Ops): Emoji OK for quick ack. For audit we need a timestamped confirmation—people-ops will reconcile LMS exports and populate timestamps.

Jules (HR Support): I'll draft a 1:1 nudge template and a short paste-in for managers to remind direct reports without spamming channels.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: managers mark teams in tracker by Mar 30; managers/manager-facing ICs complete module by Apr 12; recruiting mark EU hires during requisition close; people-ops will export LMS completions Apr 13 and reconcile. Please don't post medical info in Slack—use the secure intake form linked on the handbook page. :lock:
